mechanism: Retained finite-batch hopper/trough attempt, repaired for stack continuity and active-job visibility; not recommended for publication.
spatialBenefit: No defensible extra 3D depth. A frozen movable admission boundary would redistribute a conserved backlog along one axis; a 2D strip communicates the same relation with less visual complexity.
beyondVideoTest: Bound comparison adds counterfactual control but not a spatial relation beyond a 2D strip. The proposed frozen-backlog alternative removes playback yet remains one-dimensional, so no new alternative was built merely to claim 3D depth.
interaction: Button 1 'Run the batch' / 'Pause' / 'Continue' advances one step at a time automatically. Button 2 toggles 'Allow 7 waiting' / 'Allow 3 waiting', rolling the producer along its rails between steps. Host Reset restacks the hopper. Clicking the producer or the tool frames it (optional).
expectedObservations: With 3 places: C, D and E fill the trough while B runs; at step 6 F is held at the hopper mouth and the amber latch drops for 3 steps.
With 7 places: up to 6 jobs wait in the trough and the producer is never held.
Either way all eight jobs finish at step 15; admission into the trough is visibly separate from completion in the done tray.
limitations: Recommend omission: playback and movable bound do not earn 3D.
